sub_sector.value: Structural connectors and fasteners; concrete anchoring and repair

manufacturing_type.detail: Stamps and forms steel connectors, makes fasteners and mechanical anchors, and formulates anchoring adhesives and concrete repair products.

production_model.detail: Stocks standard catalog connectors, fasteners and anchors for distribution.

product_complexity.detail: Designs and tests structural connectors, fasteners and anchoring systems for specified loads and installation conditions.

production_role.detail: Makes branded structural connectors, fasteners and anchoring systems sold through building-product distributors and retailers.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves residential and commercial construction, remodeling, and structural repair and strengthening.

notes: The extent of custom-order production is uncertain.
